policy: Use first-party/local assets where practical; never substitute an invented likeness for a named practitioner.

practitionerMedia.fallbackBehaviour: If a verified practitioner image cannot load, show a neutral unavailable-photo state rather than an illustrative likeness.

communityMedia.externalReference: Logan Road community streetscape remains an editorial community reference; a local clinic-image fallback is configured.

digitalReception.privacy: Does not access medical records or search the public internet; visitors are instructed not to enter personal or health information.

institutionalImageGovernance.policy: No inferred authenticity. Do not fill absent clinic interior, team or governance images with generated or stock photos. Keep source masters, signed permission and derivative traceability. Existing production visuals remain unchanged until source verification.
